what_it_does.name: lark-doc
what_it_does.summary: Instructions for the lark-cli docs and mindnotes commands, for working with Feishu and Lark cloud documents of type Docx and Wiki. It reads whole documents or parts by outline, section, range or keyword, creates documents from XML or Markdown through an authoring workflow, edits them block by block, lists or reverts history versions, handles images, attachments, covers and whiteboards, and edits existing mindnotes. Results come back as JSON from lark-cli, as changed online documents or as files saved locally. Use it when the user gives a document URL or token, including doubao.com /docx/ and /wiki/ links.
tasks: read and summarise Docx and Wiki documents, whole or in part
create documents from XML or Markdown through a step-by-step authoring workflow
edit documents by text replacement or block insert, replace, move and delete
list and revert document history versions
insert, preview and download images, attachments, covers and whiteboard thumbnails
create whiteboards from Mermaid or SVG inside a document
read nodes of existing mindnotes and create or update nodes
what_it_does.author_description: 飞书云文档（Docx / Wiki）内容操作：读取、创建、编辑文档，插入或下载图片附件，以及操作思维笔记。用户提供文档 URL/token（包括 doubao.com 的 /docx/、/wiki/）时使用；按 URL 路径/token 而非域名路由；`/page/<token>` 是妙搭应用，非飞书云文档。文档内嵌资源按读取参考中的统一规则分流。独立评论操作走 lark-drive；随正文读取评论使用 docs +fetch。表格或 Base 内部数据操作不在本 skill。

risks.risk: Instructions hidden in a Lark document or its comments reach the agent when docs +fetch reads it, while the agent can create, edit and download.
risks.severity: MEDIUM by C1, SAFE overall by C2
risks.mitigation: structured XML or Markdown output and XML escaping as C2 describes, no separation of untrusted text in the files

risks.risk: An image URL in a document or a cover --url could make the CLI request internal hosts or leak data.
risks.mitigation: in place in the files, HTTPS only, private, loopback, link-local and multicast addresses refused, redirects rechecked

risks.risk: overwrite clears and rewrites the whole document and loses images, comments and unsupported resources.
risks.mitigation: use only when the user asks for a full rebuild, confirm first when comments must be kept, stated in the files

risks.risk: Facts, images or diagram content the agent searched for or made up end up in a shared document, since the authoring workflow requires filling gaps and the SVG guide asks to expand sparse descriptions.
risks.mitigation: Step 7 asks to state sources and open gaps at delivery, partly in place

risks.risk: An image on the clipboard that the user did not mean to share is uploaded to a document when --from-clipboard is used, the recommended source.
risks.mitigation: the insert is a write that needs the user's intent confirmed first, stated in the files

limitations: The mindnote path only reads existing mindnotes and creates or updates their nodes, it cannot create a new mindnote.
docs +script does not accept Markdown input, and parse is not an XML schema validator, so a passed check does not guarantee the server accepts the draft.
docs +media-insert inserts only at the end of a document and does not extract the document from /wiki/ URLs.
--from-clipboard needs xclip, wl-paste or xsel on Linux and does not read TIFF or other rare formats.
Comments returned by docs +fetch are not guaranteed to be complete.
str_replace does not replace resources, and block_replace and block_delete do not work across containers or on reversed ranges.
An html5-block is limited to 500KB of HTML, and an image by URL to 20MiB.
Whiteboards do not support pattern, clipPath, mask or non-shadow filter in SVG.
@file in Markdown content accepts only relative paths under the current working directory.

known_problems.workaround: tell the user and retry the same command with --file and a path they give
